settings.custom_css:
/* Rounded imagery, site-wide (Kosei, 2026-08-07).
   Logos, icons and round testimonial avatars are deliberately excluded. */
.elementor-widget-image img,
.elementor-widget-image-box .elementor-image-box-img img,
.elementor-widget-image-carousel .swiper-slide img,
.elementor-widget-image-gallery img,
.elementor-widget-theme-post-featured-image img,
.elementor-widget-video .elementor-custom-embed-image-overlay img,
.eael-post-list-thumbnail img,
.eael-entry-media img,
.eael-grid-post-holder img,
img.wp-post-image,
.blog-entry .thumbnail img,
.wp-block-image img{border-radius:20px;}

/* never round these */
.custom-logo,
img.custom-logo,
.site-logo img,
.footer-logo img,
#site-logo img,
.elementor-testimonial__image img,
.elementor-testimonial-image img,
.eael-testimonial-image img,
img[src$=".svg"]{border-radius:0 !important;}
.elementor-testimonial__image img,
.elementor-testimonial-image img{border-radius:50% !important;}
